_note: Reconstruction. Default key/button bindings for the Classic and Modern input presets (docs/SPEC.md 'Controls'). Every action id below is remappable at runtime via @/ui/input's rebind(); this file only supplies the out-of-the-box map, never a literal in TS. gamepadAxisThreshold is the half-axis deadzone: an axis reading must cross it (in the bound sign's direction) before that half-axis counts as pressed. cityDirectionDeadzone is a different, higher-level deadzone: it is applied to @/ui/input's already-resolved, already-combined 2D drive vector (which may come from keyboard, mouse, or gamepad) to decide whether it is firm enough to snap to one of @/app's 8 compass CityDirections, not to a single raw gamepad axis. touch.axisDeadzone is the on-screen thumbstick's own deadzone, deliberately much smaller than gamepadAxisThreshold (0.5) because a virtual stick has no spring-return rest slop to reject — reusing 0.5 would make the first half of every thumb throw dead. touch.stickRadiusPx is the thumb travel, in CSS pixels, at which the stick reads full deflection; it is the ONE number that both @/ui/touch's normalisation and the pad's rendered size derive from, so they cannot drift apart. arenaOutcomeDelayMs is UI pacing, not gameplay: the pause @/app's showArenaEvent holds once a match goes terminal (every opponent defeated, or the player's own vehicle/driver down) before cutting to the outcome screen, so the last kill or the player's own death is visible for a beat instead of the screen changing mid-frame. cityShortcuts are the CITY-only screen commands (enter/exit car, Journal, Fleet), kept OUT of actions on purpose: actions is the arena/road input table and fire already owns KeyJ in both presets, and validateControls refuses two actions sharing one physical input. The city never fires, so J is free here, and moving it would take a working, tested, on-screen-documented arena key away from players to satisfy a table the city never shares with the arena. The validator still forbids a city shortcut colliding with another city shortcut or with a DRIVE action, because those two DO coexist on the city screen.
